physDesc.physMedium: 1 bifolio. Written in ink. Paper: 18 staves. Heading on fol.1r: "Bøn (Manuscript! / bedes tilbageleveret)" and Gade's musical signature. Above the music: "Orgelstemme" although the vocal part is there as well. Organ part notated on three staves. After the final double bar-line on fol.2v Gade's musical signature. Beneath Gade has added in pencil: "Componeret / for Fru Sahlgreen / til Sahlertz Concert / Slotskirken Mai 1855". Last page blank.
